hero.blurb: A private room of serious multifamily operators scaling past 50 doors. We teach the whole process A–Z — sourcing, underwriting, financing, raising capital, and operations — alongside an accountability community that moves.

testimonials.name: Anthony
testimonials.body: I've met multiple partners, got every resource I needed to take down a deal, and I'm surrounded by more like-minded operators than ever. This turned owning at scale into being in escrow within 9 months of joining.

testimonials.name: Shane
testimonials.body: Within a few months of joining I teamed up with another member and we got a property under contract. The deal was promising enough that BCGK is partnering on it. One of the best decisions I've made.

testimonials.name: Gideon
testimonials.quote: They didn't accelerate it — they enabled it.
testimonials.body: Eight months ago I decided to scale up and joined the group. Now I'm in escrow. The support, the learning, and the relationships were critical. One of the best investments I've ever made.
